SELECT id, page, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%price%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%cost%' OR text ILIKE '%ZrO%'

SELECT id, page, statement, printed_text, value, unit FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%price%' OR statement ILIKE '%kg%' OR statement ILIKE '%cost%' OR statement ILIKE '%zro%' OR printed_text ILIKE '%kg%' OR printed_text ILIKE '%$%' OR printed_text ILIKE '%ZrO%' OR unit ILIKE '%kg%'

SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text LIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%dollar%' OR text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%€%' OR text ILIKE '%price%' OR text ILIKE '%USD%' OR text ILIKE '%/ kg%' OR text ILIKE '%kg−%' OR text ILIKE '%kg-%'
